notes.title: Game Delayed to December 4, 2023.
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

We regret to announce a delay in the game release to December 4th due to numerous bugs that require fixing. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience.

CGgT Group.
